title: Code and data for "What Demographic Prediction Can and Cannot Achieve: A Global Sensitivity Analysis of Structural Risk in Population Projections"
description: Data and scripts for the study "What Demographic Prediction Can and Cannot Achieve: A Global Sensitivity Analysis of Structural Risk in Population Projections" (Risk Analysis, revised version under review). The repository applies global sensitivity analysis and the modelling of the modelling process to two case studies: a retrospective sensitivity audit of the optimal-control model of Song et al. that underpinned China's one-child policy, and a multi-model projection of world population to 2050 and 2075 comparing cohort-component sub-models with an aggregate ARIMA paradigm. Both case studies use a Saltelli design with first-order and total-order Sobol' indices and given-data optimal-transport indices, with bootstrap confidence intervals and convergence diagnostics. The results folder holds the outputs from which the paper's tables and figures are drawn.
